rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — §9's cited docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml:58 declares input_modalities on codex and reckon.flight.declared_input_modalities resolves at reckon/flight.py:1742; c-close-s8's link #s8-codex-judges-five-png-pairs resolves to docs/evidence/archive/a-review-can-see-the-figure-landed.html:95, and the two new decisions' data-key values (svg-figure-delivery, figure-review-on-metered-lane) have no dangling target.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §9 (plan.html:227) declares a measurable done-when (tests/test_codex_declares_image_input.py passes) and a declared negative control that removes the input_modalities line from a copy of the layer and requires the test to fail; it also names the base-relative population (the tests importing reckon/flight.py) so the guard cannot pass on the unfixed code.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §9 logs under the run directory, a durable crew path, and names no session scratchpad or node-local temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §9's test filename and the symbols it names (declared_input_modalities, codex, input_modalities) are mechanism names carrying no plan label, stage name, ticket number or version tag.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass on the three checks — §9's premise (the declaration exists and nothing tests it) matches its cited evidence in §7's record (81e7d55ed), its mechanism (a test plus a fixture-removal control) can produce its done-when, and the mechanism runs on the real path through reckon.flight.resolve's project_path parameter; one presentation defect in the decisions it emits is recorded below.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §9 carries one deliverable, the test that holds codex's image declaration; it adds no second artefact and its write path is the one test file.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the plan's sole declared relationship, plan-informs="scoring-should-stop-a-promotion" (plan.html:21), resolves to an existing plan whose closed gate g-ssp-figure-lane requires a-review-can-see-the-figure#s1, and the changed units declare no new depends-on or gates that fail to resolve.
